title: Existing independent-family semantic recovery versus a same-family-permitted ablation
supersession_reason: Before any paired intervention outcome was observed, repository reconciliation confirmed that the v6 scheduler already implements the behavioral A12 distinction: semantic failures enter RECOVERY with the failed independent family excluded, while infrastructure failures enter RETRY with separate worker-health handling. The experiment is therefore reframed as an ablation of the existing behavior, not as a comparison between a new selector and the current production scheduler.
paper_track: Beyond the Parser / cause-conditioned recovery follow-on
research_question: On frozen public semantic-failure cases and an equal per-case recovery budget, does the existing independent-family semantic-recovery policy produce a different trusted-output yield or cost per trusted output than a counterfactual policy that permits a same-family recovery variation before independent-family escalation?
non_claims: Existing scheduler tests prove behavior, not quality/cost superiority.
The frozen aggregate campaign results do not contain outcomes for a same-family-permitted counterfactual arm.
The 48-case cohort is selection evidence only; no recovery arm has been executed.
No public, patent-performance, or paper-performance claim is authorized until paired intervention evidence is frozen and independently reviewed.

selection_constraints: at least two candidate model families are available
stable deterministic ordering before outcome execution
ground truth is not embedded in or mounted from this cohort manifest

arms.A_existing_cause_conditioned: Use the current v6 semantic recovery behavior: exclude the failed independent model family, choose another eligible family under the same recovery scope/budget, apply existing source/evaluator acceptance.
arms.B_same_family_permitted_ablation: Permit exactly one bounded same-family recovery variation at the same decision point before independent-family escalation. The exact same-family recipe/settings must be frozen before outcomes are scored; no post-hoc tuning.
arms.operational_control: Infrastructure/transient retry remains an implementation control and is not mixed into the semantic primary endpoint.

held_constant: base prediction and failure evidence presented to the recovery decision
recovery scope and maximum attempt/budget ceiling
independent evaluator and source-grounded acceptance revisions
execution_economy: Reuse frozen base predictions and failure routes; do not rerun the primary parser merely to create an ablation.
Run only the recovery action needed by each arm.
If an arm's exact output already exists under the same immutable action identity, reuse it rather than recomputing it.
Ground truth/evaluator labels never mount on GPU workers; GPU receives source-only inputs and outputs are scored locally.

Shard independent cases across up to four GPUs only after formal runtime READY; parallelism may reduce wall clock but must not increase the registered total-work budget by adding extra arms or repeats.
primary_endpoint: trusted-output rate on the 48 frozen semantic-failure cases
secondary_endpoints: incremental recovery yield by failure-code stratum
critical false-accept or newly introduced critical failure count
trusted_output_definition: A recovery output passes the frozen independent correctness/integrity evaluator and the source-grounded acceptance contract without a newly introduced critical failure. Agreement or model self-confidence alone never constitutes the outcome label.
statistics: exact paired success/failure table plus bootstrap confidence interval for paired yield/cost deltas where meaningful
report every stratum separately before any pooled summary
retain negative/null findings and do not change the registered primary endpoint after observing results

gpu_budget.hard_cap_rule: Never exceed USD 10 without new explicit founder authorization.

stop_before_spend_if: formal immutable runtime is not READY/qualified
source-only artifact identity cannot be reconstructed exactly
same-family ablation recipe is not frozen before scoring
predicted pilot spend exceeds the nominal cap without a smaller informative design

claim_gate.before_results: A12 IMPLEMENTED IN MULTIPLE REPOSITORY LAYERS / EMPIRICAL BENEFIT WITHHELD
claim_gate.success: Only a corpus- and arm-scoped empirical statement with denominators, exact runtime/evaluator identities, uncertainty, and receipt hashes may be considered; filing/publication remains separately gated.
claim_gate.failure_or_null: Retain the result. Do not tune the registered endpoint or silently redefine the same-family ablation after outcomes are observed.
